strategy_roster.name: MACD Enhanced Strategy MTF with Stop Loss
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish 12/26/9 MACD score with a rising MACD line approximates the cross, indicator, and histogram score components; the bearish cross exits. The 1.2-ATR(10) trailing line and multi-timeframe scoring are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Range Follower
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar session high plus 60% of ATR(14) retains the documented trigger-distance construction. Session boundaries and the residual-ATR virtual target are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: eInTradePanel
strategy_roster.notes: The long market-order branch is represented by a bullish completed candle and its inverse exit. User-selected stop, limit, stop-limit, and panel modes plus spread/ATR offsets, expiration, and virtual protection are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: AfterEffects
strategy_roster.notes: The difference between 3- and 6-bar percentage changes is a sign-preserving proxy for Close-2*Open[p]+Open[2p] with p=3 because historical opens cannot be addressed directly. The 500-point trailing stop and random inversion are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Fire EMA MA RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,13) > ema(close,62) and close > sma(close,200) and rsi(close,7) > rsi(close,28) and rsi(close,7) > 50 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(13/62), SMA(200), RSI(7/28), and rising volume retain the documented long confluence on one series; 4-hour confirmation is approximated by rolling volume. The explicit 2% stop and 4% target are retained; trailing and ATR exits are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Pipso Night Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented counterintuitive long branch enters below the prior 36-candle low and exits above its high. The 21:00 session window and three-range-width dynamic stop are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Fxscalper
strategy_roster.notes: A cross above the 20-period, 2-standard-deviation upper band and the opposite lower-band cross follow the Bollinger breakout. The 200/150 pip or point protections are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: P-Square Nth Percentile
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger 30-period bounds at the normal 90th/10th percentiles approximate upper and lower P-Square estimates on prices. Percentile, lookback, and UseReturns are unspecified, so these are explicit fallbacks and returns mode is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Virtual Robot
strategy_roster.notes: A two-ATR decline from the 20-bar high is a price-normalized proxy for filling lower virtual grid levels, with midpoint recovery as exit. Grid queues, pip spacing, volume escalation, and basket targets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Outlier Detector with N-Sigma Confidence Intervals
strategy_roster.notes: A 30-sample z-score of one-bar price changes crossing below -3 enters the long extreme, and returning inside plus or minus 2 exits. All documented periods and limits are retained and no stop is specified.
